opposition.claim: Opposition leaders reported cooperation and working groups; not a verified post-election coalition agreement.

raam.claim: Eisenkot publicly ruled out Raam participation in its current form and stated conditions for Arab/Haredi partners.

netanyahu.claim: Eisenkot ruled out serving in a Netanyahu-led government, including rotation.

minority.claim: Liberman rejected a minority government and joining Netanyahu. A minority scenario retaining his party conflicts with that statement.

haredi.claim: Reported Haredi-source assessments of possible flexibility are not confirmed party agreements.

process.claim: Outside support or abstention can affect government confidence; no particular agreement is verified here.

definitions.p61: Share of original seat draws where selected cabinet parties total61 or more.
definitions.confidence: Share of original draws where cabinet+outside-support seats exceed opposing seats, conditional on fixed roles, all members attending, and all unselected parties opposing.
definitions.formation: Not estimated. Arithmetic percentages do not estimate willingness, agreements, appointment or government survival.

political_position_freshness: Reported statements from dates shown, checked in this session; not a live tracker of every later negotiation. Disputed and unverified combinations remain labeled.
